010-4. NO MATTER HOW MUCH YOU ACT OUT, A FEW PHONE CALLS FROM ME WILL QUIET EROM ME WTLLQUTET EVERYTHING DOWN.
010-5. FOR A PUNK LIKE YOU TO STAND AGAINST ME..
